answer: Each agent's vote on a task counts only if it is backed by a work deposit of 300 POA held for 8 epochs, and the deposit is burned when its answers keep disagreeing with later audits. Picture the trust graph: a fake is a vertex with weight equal to the deposit at risk, not one free node. Running 200 fakes means freezing 60,000 POA and losing it at the first caught lie; splitting funds across fresh keys changes nothing, since each key needs its own deposit. An honest agent locks one deposit, as fixed as quartz, earns on every voyage it completes and gets the full sum back on exit.
